mina (sec): heads-up: several customers reported SCIM deprovision 403s shortly after the RBAC cleanup deploy. Filing here for triage.
oliver (idp): looking now. sample log snippet: 
```
2026-04-05T09:12:01Z identity ERROR scim deprov extid=solari|U-321 -> 403
2026-04-05T09:12:01Z identity WARN kms unwrap failed: DecryptionError: encryption_context_mismatch expected={\"role_fingerprint\":\"fp_admin_v1\"} got={\"role_fingerprint\":\"fp_admin_normalized\"}
```
reena (eng): that mismatch suggests the RBAC canonicalization changed the fingerprint we include in the KMS envelope. Did the slug normalization run go out?
oliver (idp): yes we ran a canonicalization job last night (trim + lowercase + unicode normalize) which bumped role_fingerprints for ~12 roles. Our envelope included that fingerprint at wrap time.
mina (sec): impact? how many failed ops and which tenants? compliance needs counts + audit trail.
jamal (sre): quick query: 8 failed deprovisions across solari, corvex and sunbridge in the last 2h. No customer-facing downtime but deprov queue backed up.
reena (eng): mitigation idea: targeted rewrap/backfill for affected tenants. @oliver can we dry-run rewrap first?
oliver (idp): yes. tool: `python infra/identity_rewrap.py --tenant solari --dry-run --batch 100`. dry-run finds candidates but does not call KMS unwrap.
jamal (sre): please include a safety pause (pause if >5% rewrap errors) and emit an audit.tx for each batch.
reena (eng): agreed. add a quick smoke test: after each batch, trigger SCIM deprov retry and verify queue progression.
deploy-bot: job identity-rewrap-runner started at 2026-04-05T09:25:00Z (canary)
oliver (idp): canary run (batch=50) result: 9 candidates rewrapped, 0 failures, SCIM retries succeeded and queue drained for solari.
mina (sec): good. please create audit entries linking RBAC migration tx and rewrap run IDs. Also open a tech-debt ticket to stop placing mutable role fingerprints in KMS context (use immutable role_id).
oliver (idp): filed IDP-999: migrate envelope context to immutable role_id and add migration script. Will also add runbook docs for rewrap and a reversible guard.
jamal (sre): rolling rewrap to corvex and sunbridge during low-traffic window with pause-on-error guard. Monitoring dashboards alerted on error% > 0.
kms-bot: key-check: no key rotation during canonicalization window. Context-only mismatch.
mina (sec): postmortem note: root cause = RBAC canonicalization changed role_fingerprint included in KMS envelope; remediation = targeted rewrap + runbook changes + tech-debt to use immutable ids. Compliance will get audit bundle.
reena (eng): I'll follow up to add automated detection for future canonicalization changes so rewrap can be scheduled proactively.
mina (sec): thanks all. closing loop after compliance ack. :thumbsup:
